context.description: The phase-1 runner reads readiness and completion from the machine

evidence.trustReason: Given the post-phase-1 runner, the test drives its successor RunSupervisor with a real Recorder and event store. When the run proceeds, each spawned task has a ready tag and trusted dependencies; added-ready and removed-ready controls show it starts by the snapshot tag alone. Outside trust facts and duplicate forwarding show no independent trusted set; an unsettled machine with all units trusted stays active, showing no separate done decision. Stored facts in both runs lack run.ended, and the source AST permits only a failed-state run.ended fact. Holding S5 keeps the run active; its trust makes the snapshot done and closes the supervisor. The lint return change leaves these controls and assertions intact.
